mapper.select: SELECT mr.room_id, mr.room_name, mr.capacity, mr.room_status, mr.manager_id, t.name AS manager_name FROM MEETING_ROOM mr LEFT JOIN TEACHER t ON mr.manager_id = t.teacher_id ORDER BY mr.room_id

SELECT mr.room_id, mr.room_name, mr.capacity, mr.room_status, mr.manager_id, t.name AS manager_name FROM MEETING_ROOM mr LEFT JOIN TEACHER t ON mr.manager_id = t.teacher_id WHERE mr.room_id = #{roomId}

SELECT mr.room_id, mr.room_name, mr.capacity, mr.room_status, mr.manager_id, t.name AS manager_name FROM MEETING_ROOM mr LEFT JOIN TEACHER t ON mr.manager_id = t.teacher_id WHERE mr.room_status = 1 ORDER BY mr.room_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEETING_ROOM (room_name, capacity, room_status, manager_id) VALUES (#{roomName}, #{capacity}, #{roomStatus}, #{managerId})
mapper.update: UPDATE MEETING_ROOM SET room_name = #{roomName}, capacity = #{capacity}, room_status = #{roomStatus}, manager_id = #{managerId} WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEETING_ROOM WHERE room_name = #{roomName}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEETING_ROOM WHERE room_name = #{roomName} AND room_id != #{roomId}
